evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM).
